Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova, et amplissima collectio ... quae Joannes Dominicus Mansi evulgavit. Tomus trigesimus secundus: ab anno MCDXXXVIII ad annum MDIL
Creator: Giovanni Domenico Mansi (ed.), after Philippe Labbe, Gabriel Cossart and Nicolas Coleti
Publisher: Facsimile reproduction for H. Welter, Paris and Leipzig, of the Venice edition (original: Antonio Zatta)
Publication Date: 1901
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: the title page reads 'POUR H. WELTER, ÉDITEUR, Rue Bernard-Palissy, no 4, PARIS ET A LEIPZIG ... 1901' (the year is read in the OCR as 'IQOI') and 'TOMUS TRIGESIMUS SECUNDUS ... EXPENSIS HUBERTI WELTER'; the underlying edition is of the 1790s; the item record carries no rights field.
Language: lat (the Latin acts of the Council of Florence's aftermath, the Lateran V and Pisan conciliabulum acts and later councils; the long s is read as f)
Source: Internet Archive item sacrorumconcilio0032joan (archive.org/details/sacrorumconcilio0032joan), full-text file sacrorumconcilio0032joan_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; the OCR text follows unchanged apart from this header. Nothing stripped, normalised, corrected, re-spaced or retyped. Latin sampled at opening, middle and end: the long s is read as f; otherwise readable with scattered errors. A second witness for exact wording until checked against the page images. This file is 4.4 MB, over the 3 MB limit for second witnesses, and is vendored under the exception for a council's core acts with no smaller edition.
Content note: Mansi tomus 32, 1438 to 1549 as the title page reads: it carries 'Concilium Lateranense V' (the acts of Julius II and Leo X, 1512-1517, headed 'Lateranense V. Oecumenicum Concilium' in the volume), the 'Conciliabulum Pisanum' of 1511 and later documents. Only the Lateran V and Pisan acts fall inside the window; the rest of the volume is later and is kept whole. The decrees of Fifth Lateran, the last conciliar act before 1517, are in it.
